name: Admin Unified Defaults Shell
description: Admin navigates to /panel/defaults — a unified shell page with a Propuesta/Diagnóstico mode switch. Default mode is proposal. Clicking Diagnóstico updates the URL to ?mode=diagnostic and renders DiagnosticDefaultsPanel. Direct navigation to ?mode=diagnostic lands in diagnostic mode. The back link label changes by mode (Volver a Propuestas / Volver a Diagnósticos). Old routes /panel/proposals/defaults, /panel/proposals/email-templates and /panel/diagnostics/defaults redirect here preserving their mode/tab intent.
